thread:
Maya R.: Heads-up — I'm prototyping a compact route+model mini-dashboard card for Console. Goal is quick filters + a single-click 'Save view' that preserves sampling and routing hints. Sketch coming, but need to agree on API shape and migration plan before I wire the UI. Thoughts?

Ben C.: Love the idea. Quick Q: should saved views capture an explicit sample_rate, or just reference the route default? If route defaults change later, users might be surprised.

Jess L.: I'd prefer explicit sample_rate on save. UX idea: show a tiny badge on the card e.g. `sample: 2%` and a preview of estimated token burn on hover.

Tom P.: Backend note: current saved_query schema only has `route_id` + `query` blob. Adding `sample_rate` and `pinned_model` is fine but needs a migration strategy + fallback semantics. Proposal: make new fields optional; if absent, fall back to route default.

Maya R.: That works. For rollout we'll do canary (5% internal -> 100%). Need FF gating + console toggle. @ops-bot can we gate?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: yes — use feature flag `console.savedview.v2`. You can set percentage targeting in LaunchDarkly. I can also automate gradual promotion if you include `ff:console.savedview.v2` in the feature manifest.

Ben C.: One API question: should routing hints be a formal object instead of freeform meta? Something like:

```json
{
  "route_id": "r-123",
  "model_id": "m-llama2-13b-q4",
  "routing_policy": "latency", // latency | cost | regional
  "sample_rate": 0.02
}
```

Jess L.: Yes, formalize it. Draft contract for save payload: `route_id`, `model_id`, `routing_policy`, `sample_rate`, `display_name`, `spec_version`. Also store `created_by` and a cached `last_preview_token_burn`.

Tom P.: Storing cached preview is ok, but computing token burn requires running a small prompt batch against the current model/quant. That's potentially expensive on save. Suggest: capture an initial quick estimate at save time (cheap path) and schedule a background worker to compute a more accurate preview, cache TTL 24h. UI can show `stale` badge if older than TTL.

Maya R.: :thumbsup: cheap immediate estimate + background job + TTL = good compromise.

Ben C.: UX: card header shows `preview: ~12k tokens/hr` + `Update preview` action. For canary expose `BETA` tag on saved view header. Also keyboard shortcut `s` to quick-save from filters panel.

Jess L.: Edge-case: saved views that rely on route-default sample (i.e., `sample_rate` is null) will silently drift if route default changes. We must surface that in UI: "uses route default (2%) — route default changed" with a CTA to pin the sample or accept update.

Tom P.: Migration plan: new saves will copy route default into `sample_rate` at save time (explicit). Existing saves keep null. We'll add an admin migration job that can optionally materialize sample_rate for all existing saves. Also adding `spec_version: "2"` to detect old vs new saves.

Maya R.: Implementation owners: I'll handle front-end card + UX copy, Ben will wire the preview CTA and keyboard shortcut, Tom does schema + migration + background preview job, Jess will update the API contract docs and add `spec_version`. Ops-bot will handle the FF canary. I'll open a GH issue and PRs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag created: `console.savedview.v2` set to 5% internal. Ping when PRs are ready and I'll promote.

Ben C.: Tiny nit — we should include `display_context` for quick sharing (e.g., `team:payments`), helpful for search.

Jess L.: Agreed. Also add `last_modified_by` and `last_preview_at` timestamps.

Maya R.: Working notes / API snippet I'll put in the GH issue (copy below).

```http
POST /api/v1/saved_views
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "route_id": "r-123",
  "model_id": "m-llama2-13b-q4",
  "routing_policy": "latency",
  "sample_rate": 0.02,
  "display_name": "Payments - high latency filter",
  "spec_version": "2",
  "display_context": "team:payments"
}
```

Maya R.: I'll link the issue here once created and drop the visual mock. Thanks all — hitting up design for tiny badge assets @Ben.

Ben C.: I'll make a 16px badge and add hover text.

Tom P.: I'll add the migration PR tomorrow.

Jess L.: I'll update the API docs RFC and add examples for the client SDKs.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: when ready, run `/deploy promote console.savedview.v2 50%` and tag me in the PR.
